rows.grounds: fused form of mantra, iva, viśuddha, citta in genitive

items.question: For whom does kula knowledge shine forth?
items.inference: Kula knowledge shines forth for one whose mind is purified by mantra.
uncertainties: exact force of iva within the fused form
items.plain_english: Kula knowledge shines forth for one whose mind is purified by mantra.

items.question: What is said about those established in kula dharma?
premises: those established in kula dharma are named
all of them share this quality
items.inference: All who are established in kula dharma are non-returning.
uncertainties: whether sarve modifies ye or te
items.plain_english: All those established in kula dharma are non-returning.

items.question: For which men does kula knowledge shine forth?
premises: men whose sins are worn away are named
the address is to the goddess
items.inference: Kula knowledge shines forth for men whose sins are worn away.
uncertainties: whether kṣīṇāṃhasāṃ is adjectival or part of a compound
items.plain_english: Kula knowledge shines forth for men whose sins are worn away.

rows.grounds: compound of devatā, guru, bhakti in instrumental

items.question: By what means does kula knowledge shine forth?
premises: devotion to deity and guru is named
items.inference: Kula knowledge shines forth through devotion to deity and guru.
uncertainties: whether ca connects to a previous verse
items.plain_english: Kula knowledge shines forth through devotion to deity and guru.

rows.grounds: compound of ati and bhakta in genitive

items.question: For whom does kula knowledge shine forth here?
items.inference: Kula knowledge shines forth for the great devotee of the secret.
uncertainties: whether guhyasya modifies atibhaktasya or stands separately
items.plain_english: Kula knowledge shines forth for the great devotee of the secret.

items.question: Whose firm devotion brings kula knowledge?
premises: whose devotion is firm is named
items.inference: For one whose devotion is firm, kula knowledge shines forth.
uncertainties: whether tasya is anaphoric to yasya
items.plain_english: For one whose devotion is firm, kula knowledge shines forth.

rows.grounds: compound of guru, ājñā, pālaka, dharma in instrumental plural

items.question: How is kula knowledge obtained?
premises: dharmas of guru-command keepers are named
it is obtained by those dharmas
items.inference: Kula knowledge is obtained through the dharmas of those who keep the guru's command.
uncertainties: whether dharmaiḥ modifies pālakaiḥ or the whole compound
items.plain_english: Kula knowledge is obtained through the dharmas of those who keep the guru's command.

items.question: What should be spoken after testing?
premises: kula knowledge spoken by me is named
items.inference: Therefore, after testing, the kula knowledge spoken by me should be spoken.
uncertainties: whether vaktavyaṃ is impersonal or addressed to a disciple
items.plain_english: Therefore, after testing, the kula knowledge I have spoken should be imparted.

items.question: What happens to one who breaks command?
items.inference: Whoever breaks command obtains the curse of the deity.
uncertainties: whether ājñābhaṅgañca and ca are separate or fused in sense
items.plain_english: Whoever breaks command obtains the curse of the deity.

items.question: What becomes of guru and disciple?
items.inference: Both guru and disciple become beasts of the yoginis.
uncertainties: whether sa refers to the command-breaker from the previous verse
items.plain_english: Both guru and disciple become beasts of the yoginis.

items.question: What do the two obtain directly?
items.inference: The two directly obtain union of yogini and vira.
uncertainties: who the two are in this context
items.plain_english: The two directly obtain union of yogini and vira.

items.question: What follows from knowing this kula dharma?
premises: having known it one is liberated
items.inference: Knowing this kula dharma, one is liberated, and there is no doubt.
uncertainties: whether nātra refers to this teaching or this place
items.plain_english: Knowing this kula dharma, one is liberated, and there is no doubt.
